title: Health Indicator New Vision
description: Health Indicator New Vision - mod for display player health in nametag
body:
💖 New Vision
"Display health in nametag" — Your ultimate multiplayer awareness tool!

Enhance your Minecraft multiplayer experience with this simple yet highly effective mod! Say goodbye to guessing how much health your friends (or foes) have left. This mod seamlessly integrates a real-time health indicator directly into every player's nametag, hovering right above their head.

P.S. TAKE HP NUMBERS from TAB/BELOWNAME/DIRECT.

✨ Key Features
❤️ Real-Time Tracking: Instantly see the exact health points of any player in your line of sight.

⚔️ PvP Advantage: Plan your attacks perfectly by knowing exactly when your opponent is one hit away from defeat.

🤝 Co-Op Lifesaver: Keep an eye on your teammates during intense boss fights or dungeon raids so you know exactly when to throw that splash potion of healing!

🎨 Clean Integration: Looks natural and blends perfectly with the vanilla Minecraft aesthetic without cluttering your UI.

💡 Why you need it: Whether you are dominating in a PvP arena, running a hardcore survival server, or just adventuring with friends, knowing everyone's health status at a glance is an absolute game-changer! 🛡️🗡️

⚖️ Built for Fair Play: Balanced & Cheat-Free
Because a great mod shouldn't break the game!

We believe that tactical awareness shouldn't come at the cost of game balance. That's why this mod is built from the ground up with strict fair play mechanics, ensuring it feels like a natural vanilla feature rather than an unfair advantage.

🔍 How It Keeps Things Fair
👁️ Strict Line of Sight: No wallhacks here! The health indicator only renders when a player is completely visible to you. If your opponent retreats behind a wall, ducks behind a tree, or breaks your line of sight, their health status remains a mystery.

👻 Respects Invisibility: Love using stealth? So do we! If a player uses a Potion of Invisibility, their health bar completely vanishes alongside their nametag. Your covert operations, escapes, and sneak attacks remain 100% viable and protected.

🛡️ True Vanilla Balance: The mod doesn't pull or display data from players you can't legitimately see. It operates entirely within the boundaries of honest gameplay, making it absolutely perfect for competitive PvP servers and vanilla-friendly communities.

🎯 The Verdict: You get the ultimate convenience of health tracking, but you still have to earn it through direct combat and smart positioning. It's the perfect balance of quality-of-life and fair competition! 🤝✨
